name: webapp-harness
description: Operate a deterministic GitHub issue-backed web-application development harness with evidence-backed backlog generation.

interface.shortDescription: Generate and complete verified sequential backlogs.
interface.longDescription: Configure a GitHub issue-backed harness without adding repository state files, audit evidence-backed gaps into a user-confirmed issue backlog, then process ready tasks sequentially through implementation, verification, logic review, browser validation, and per-task commits until complete.
defaultPrompt: Initialize the development harness and preview its first evidence-backed backlog.
Audit this repository for gaps and propose backlog tasks for my confirmation.
Run the verified backlog sequentially until it is complete.
